CustomObject.description:
Create a Platform event in Salesforce that signals when a new customer needs to be created in SKP.
1. Case.NCSP_Service_line__c ="RM", "RM Pathology", "Vault Climate Control", "One Time Shred" or "Shred" 2. Opportunity Type = New Deal 3. Case Status = New 4. Case.Record Type = NCSP: SKP New Customer Set Up 5. Service Address Country: USA or CANADA. 6. Contract status is Accepted.
A platform event is created, which is subscribed by Mule application.
CustomObject.label: Mulesoft_NCSP_Customer_Creation
